caseName: New York Central & Hudson River Railroad v. McConnell
caseNameFull: New York Central & Hudson River Railroad Company, in Error v. Samuel P. McConnell
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of North Carolina.
attorneys: Mr. Walter H. Neal for the plaintiff in error., Mr. S. S. Gregory for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Eustis v. Bolles, 150 U. S. 361; Wood v. Chesborough, 228 U. S. 672, 677; New Orleans & N. E. R. R. v. National Rice Milling Co., 234 U. S. 80, 86; Mellon Co. v. McCafferty, 239 U. S., ante, p. 134.
